title: Wan-Alpha++: Animating a Single RGBA Asset into Controllable Transparent Video Effects
abstract: RGBA video generation is essential for creating compositable visual assets in filmmaking, game development, and digital content production. However, generating high-quality RGB appearance alongside temporally coherent transparency remains a significant challenge. Existing text-to-RGBA video methods often entangle RGB and alpha distributions and offer limited control over the precise appearance of a target asset. In addition, incorporating image conditioning typically suffers from the emergence-disappearance effects, which fail existing first-frame or first-and-last-frame conditions due to their fully transparent boundary frames. To address these issues, we present Wan-Alpha++, a unified framework that brings controllable RGBA video generation to both text- and image-to-video diffusion backbones through a shared RGBA latent space, extending our conference version Wan-Alpha from the text-conditioned setting to image-conditioned generation with an interior reference frame. Our method first learns shiftable RGB-alpha distributions while preserving the pretrained RGB prior. Specifically, we introduce a transparency-aware bidirectional diffusion objective to produce distinguishable RGBA latent representations, and a transparency-guided mean sampler that shifts the noise distribution to improve transparency generation and enable spatial controllability. Building upon this RGBA generation prior, we introduce temporal phase reparameterization for image-conditioned effect generation. By cyclically transforming a zero-positive-zero alpha pattern into a positive-zero-positive pattern, it relocates visible content to both temporal boundaries, facilitating effective appearance conditioning with limited RGBA data.

analysis.ideaZh: Wan-Alpha++ 从一张RGBA素材生成可合成的透明显隐动画：先分离RGB/alpha表示，再把“透明→可见→透明”的时间相位旋转为可沿用首尾帧条件的序列，最后用透明状态梯度指导并旋转回来。作者报告effect任务DINO-I从0.6679到0.9227；适合关注layered asset workflow，但只验证小规模素材与单段显隐，image-conditioned推理仍有显著guidance成本。
analysis.motivationZh: 现有首帧/首尾帧I2V要求边界含可见主体，而透明特效常在首尾完全消失；post-hoc matting又易丢失半透明内容。Wan-Alpha++沿用Wan-Alpha的共享RGBA latent与transparency-guided noise mean，将可见中间帧循环移到首尾以复用pretrained I2V条件接口；推理时同一RGBA输入约束两个端点，对内部透明区间执行归一化gradient guidance，再逆时间旋转输出。实验既含text-to-RGBA，也含normal/effect image-to-RGBA；主要直接用途是可合成视觉素材，非SVG或vector结构生成。

analysis.experimentsZh: RGBA VAE训练77,237 clips/4,066 validation；T2V/I2V初始适配采用精选429素材，另196段emergence-disappearance effect videos做phase适配。以Wan2.1 T2V/I2V 14B为backbone，每个T2V和I2V设置评60个视频，作者称训练测试无同source asset/重叠clip；40名参与者ranking。 作者报告effect I2RGBA的DINO-I 0.9227、CLIP-I 0.9368，baseline Wan2.1-FLF2V+MatAnyone分别0.6679、0.7969。 (Table4,p.14) 作者报告normal I2RGBA的DINO-I 0.9066 vs 0.9033、CLIP-I 0.9445 vs 0.9089；normal与effect不能混为同一增幅。 (Table4,p.14) 作者报告effect用户temporal-effect ranking为1.12 vs baseline1.88、overall为1.16 vs1.84，越低越好。 (Table5,p.14) 作者报告rotation only DINO-I0.9136、rotation+guidance0.9227，temporal-effect rank由2.09降至1.12。 (Table6,p.16) T2V比较LayerFlow、LayerDiffuse+AnimateDiff、open/closed TransPixeler及Wan+MatAnyone；image-conditioned因缺少直接RGBA方法采用同Wan I2V/FLF2V+MatAnyone两阶段baseline。白背景composite下的RGB评估不能完全衡量alpha；baseline显隐/初始化限制也使大幅effect收益不能外推为所有I2V质量优势。 RGBA representation用rendering、TABD、mean sampler的逐项消融；新增I2V部分分离phase rotation与guidance，并扫步长和guidance步数。Table7显示过强/过久guidance损伤细节；缺少丰富multi-stage visibility、复杂多asset interaction和大规模分布外测试。
analysis.insightZh: 相对原conference Wan-Alpha，新增重点是data-efficient image conditioning：借助visibility-aware phase rotation将难学的interior reference转换为已有boundary conditioning，并用低复杂度transparent-state guidance决定消失区间。底层RGBA VAE/TABD和mean sampler来自此前版本；不能把全部T2V能力当本次独有突破。
analysis.evidenceZh: RGBA VAE用独立RGB/alpha编码、merge与decoder LoRA，并以signed bidirectional loss保留opaque RGB先验而移动非opaque latents。 (Sec.3.2, Eqs.(1)–(11), pp.4–5; Fig.1,p.5) / temporal rotation把可见interior frames移到首尾，保留motion与alpha演变而复用预训练FLF2V接口。 (Sec.3.3.2, Eqs.(14)–(18), p.6; Fig.2,p.7) / transparent-state guidance更新用户指定invisible interval，再经inverse rotation复原特效。 (Secs.3.3.4–3.3.5, Eqs.(22)–(29), pp.6–7; Fig.4,p.8) / 作者报告effect任务reference fidelity与normal RGBA质量改善。 (Table4,p.14) / 作者报告去除phase rotation和guidance后DINO-I为0.6315，加入rotation为0.9136，二者齐全为0.9227。 (Table6,p.16) / I2V evaluation为81帧480×832、40 sampling steps，其中前32步各2–3轮guidance。 (Sec.4.1.1,p.9; Table7,p.16)
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 其RGB-alpha disentanglement、可控透明边界和可直接composite的asset输出，对layered 2D visual creation有具体迁移价值；不是structured vector/SVG生成证据。
analysis.caveatZh: Conclusion把更复杂multi-stage transparency events和减少gradient-guidance额外推理成本列为未来方向（p.16）。 / Sec.4.3明确过大guidance step或全40步指导会损伤visible-frame细节（pp.14–16,Table7）。 / Spatial ellipse仅约束coarse foreground位置和extent，保留fine details自由度，不是精确几何控制（Sec.4.2,pp.11–12）。 / 无显式独立Limitations章节；p.16 future work及p.14–16超参数边界是作者陈述，其他局限为审阅者推断。 / 每设置60视频、196 effect训练片段；尚不足以支持任意长视频、多次显隐、跨asset interaction或生产workflow稳定性。 / DINO/CLIP/aesthetic只在alpha support均值>0.5的visible frames上评，且RGB composited-white评估对真实多背景alpha质量覆盖有限。 / 40步I2V中额外gradient/VAE decode成本未给完整wall-clock对照；不能将T2V四步采样称作本新增任务实时。 / 论文页眉为TPAMI模板不单独证明录用；本轮按arXiv exact v1证据记录。
